claims: The 2026 Oscars featured a tie in the Best Live Action Short Film category between "The Singers" and "Two People Exchanging Saliva".
The tie in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 2026 Oscars marks only the seventh tie in the Academy's nearly 100-year history.
Kumail Nanjiani announced the tie in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 2026 Oscars.
The tie in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 2026 Oscars is the first Oscar tie since 2013.
"Skyfall" and "Zero Dark Thirty" tied for Sound Editing at the 2013 Oscars.
